memory_candidates.content: Lean4 plan artifacts in this repo carry a `## Lean Challenge Statements` section whose declared identifier set must EXACTLY equal the backtick identifiers under `**Goals**:`. The cross-validator is scripts/lean-challenge-snapshot.sh: it extracts Goals names with `grep -oP '`[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_']*`'` (so DOTTED names like `Ns.thm` match nothing and are invisible) and extracts declared names with a regex matching only `theorem|lemma|def|instance` followed by an undotted identifier (so `structure` declarations do NOT enter the set, and `def Ns.foo` captures `Ns`, not `foo`). Practical consequences when authoring a lean4 plan: declare everything inside `namespace` blocks with simple undotted names; list defs and named instances in Goals alongside theorems, since they are captured too; give Decidable instances explicit names rather than leaving them anonymous. Verify before returning with `bash .claude/scripts/lean-challenge-snapshot.sh <task> <project_root> --dry-run`, which exits 71 with the offending identifiers on mismatch. Note also that the snapshot tool's module assembly slices from the first declaration match onward, so interleaved `structure` declarations are dropped from the assembled Challenge module.
